title: V2-FIX — Fix Scorsese agent JSON parsing (empty scenes bug)
description: All v2 pipeline runs produce 0 scenes because parseScenarioBundle corrupts JSON with a regex that breaks on escaped quotes. Fix: proper brace-balanced JSON extraction, safe newline fixer, wider self-repair trigger.
